title: Delivery Governance & Performance Visibility
summary: Built integrated project tracking, capacity planning, budget monitoring, and margin dashboards — giving project managers and leadership real-time visibility into project health and resource utilization.

projectItems.title: Integrated Project Governance & Status Suite
projectItems.summary: Standardized project initiation checklists, milestone tracking, escalation paths, and automated PDF status reporting across project delivery teams.
projectItems.problemStatement: Projects lacked uniform tracking standards across teams. Project kickoff criteria were informal, status updates were sent in varying email formats, and leadership couldn't quickly assess portfolio risk or milestone status.
projectItems.solution: Built standardized project initiation templates in Zoho Projects and Creator. Configured mandatory milestone gates, severity-based issue escalation rules, and an automated script that generates formatted PDF status updates for client and management reviews.
projectItems.impact: Standardized project delivery tracking across teams, ensuring issues are surfaced early and status reporting is consistent and automated.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Establishes clear operational guardrails for project managers without cluttering daily execution work.

projectItems.title: Project Delivery & Financial Performance Dashboard
projectItems.summary: Architected a flagship project intelligence dashboard (normalized delivery dataset) providing real-time project profitability, budget burn-rate tracking, margin alerts, and role-based views for Directors, Project Managers, and Finance.
projectItems.problemStatement: Checking project financial health required manually pulling data from Zoho Books and Projects during monthly reviews. Budget overruns were discovered late because there was no live alert mechanism, and runtime API calls caused slow report loading.
projectItems.solution: Built a normalized, background-synchronized data layer aggregating data from Books, Projects, and Creator. Created budget burn-rate tracking with margin deviation alerts (Green/Amber/Red) and customized role-based dashboard views.
projectItems.impact: Estimated 191.25 hours saved monthly across 45 users by replacing manual spreadsheet checking with a real-time, high-speed dashboard. Allowed management to spot margin slippage early.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Combines project delivery metrics with accounting data into an automated, fast-loading executive dashboard.

projectItems.title: Resource Capacity Planning & Timesheet Workflow
projectItems.summary: Designed a weekly resource management workflow covering engineer task planning, manager review and approval, automated Zoho Projects time-logging, and cross-department utilization dashboards.
projectItems.problemStatement: Resource allocation was managed on offline spreadsheets. Department leads had no clear view of billable vs available capacity, weekly time submission was inconsistent, and manual data re-keying was needed for project logs.
projectItems.solution: Developed a custom Zoho Creator application where engineers log weekly task plans, managers review and approve allocations, and approved hours sync directly into Zoho Projects time logs. Built capacity vs utilization analytics views by department.
projectItems.impact: Replaced fragmented spreadsheets with a single structured workflow, giving business heads clear visibility into team loading and unallocated bandwidth.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Streamlines weekly timesheet management while giving department heads real-time capacity visibility for proactive staffing.
